{{Quote|Welcome to my Empire of Art!|Perek|<ref name=":1" />}}
The '''Empire of Art''' was a radical faction led by [[Cronal|Perek]], formally the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] named Cronal, after he infected the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] with his [[Art virus]].

== History ==

=== Origins ===
{{Quote|Witness the beauty in collapse, the exquisite terror of architecture!|Perek|<ref name=":1" />}}
Following his failed attempt to [[Essence transfer|possess]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his brush with [[Death/Legends|death]] after the [[Battle of Mindor]], [[Cronal]] forsook his [[Sorcerers of Rhand|Rhandite]] [[Way of the Dark|philosophy]] and sought to find his [[Sariss|daughter]] to beg for her forgiveness. Upon finding her [[Death/Legends|dead]] body on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], his guilt and heartbreak caused him to loose all grip on reality. He abandoned his philosophy of entropy and wholly embraced the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] art of [[mechu-deru]]. He began blending technology with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alcehmy]] to therapeutically sow creation from the seed of destruction, dubbing this process "[[Stygian Art|Stygian art]]". He experimented with his new artform on [[Trailia]] before moving to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] undercity. After he failed to forge [[Irek Ismaren]], son of the former Emperor's Hand [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]], into an artistic masterpiece, he fled to [[Andooweel/Legends|Andooweel]] and fashioned himself as a cyber-artist named Perek.<ref name=":0">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref>   

=== Preparations ===
{{Quote|Down with the flesh! Machine is terror! Terror is art! Art is the new Empire!|C-3PO|<ref name=":1" />}}
Perek's next project was to create an "Empire of Art". He developed an "[[Art virus]]" that worked similarly to the [[Nanogene spore|Nanogene]] [[Nanogene droid|technovirus]] developed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Belia Darzu]].<ref>''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Flesh was used as fuel for the virus as it transmuted living tissue into mechanical parts. The virus was also capable of transforming [[Droid/Legends|droids]] into technological monstrosities. Perek collected equipment and personnel from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and transformed them into works of art. Vehicles and equipment were turned into sculptures and art installations, while the troops were infected with his virus and transformed into [[Technobeast|technobeasts]]. He then abducted at least a dozen [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawlers]] worth of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and infected them with his virus. The clouds of insects that covered the Jawas' faces were also infected with the virus and were transformed into micro-droids. Perek planned to use this technobeast army to infect the galaxy with his virus and rebuild it into an Empire of Art.<ref name=":1">''[[Collapsing New Empires|"Collapsing New Empires" —]] [[Star Wars Tales 19]]''</ref>

=== Defeat ===
{{Quote|Don't resist the machine in you. Soon, like your father, you will be mostly machine!|Perek|<ref name=":1" />}}
In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Luke Skywalker's [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] hand, which had been alchemically-altered with mechu-deru by the [[Cloning/Legends|reborn]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]], drew him to Andooweel. While a team consisting of Luke, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] interrogated Perek, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] stayed behind on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]. Perek's micro-droids boarded the ship and transformed the two droids into Stygian monstrosities. When the team returned to the Falcon, they defeated a group of technobeast Jawas and discovered Perek's dark secret. They were then captured by R2-D2 and C-3PO so Perek could harvest their bodies. The micro-droids attacked Luke and infected the circuitry of his prosthetic hand with the Art virus. The virus precipitated a monstrous metamorphosis in Luke's hand. Once the infection spread up Luke's arm to the rest of his body, he would become more machine than man, just like his [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|father]].<ref name=":1" /> This would be Perek's most magnificent creation, a perfect vessel for him to possess.<ref name=":0" /> Once Luke was fully transformed, Perek planned to rule his Empire of Art from his body just as he had planned to possess Luke at [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] and rule the Imperial Remnant from his body after [[Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge|establishing]] him as the heir to the Empire.<ref>[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor|''Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor'']]</ref> Before this could occur, Luke tracked Perek down, strangled the sorcerer to death with his infected arm, and cut it off before the virus could reach the rest of his body. Han Solo and Chewbacca crafted a [[Corellian spark grenade]] and short-circuited the rest of Perek's creations.<ref name=":1" />
